# ECONOMY
\n
MAWC operates under a nomadic [bold]Salvager[/bold] economy. [bold]Advanced materials[/bold] come at an easy price, and can be made en masse. However, the only way to obtain these is to scrap [bold]derelict hulls[/bold] that may be left around the sector.
MAWC [bold][color=yellow]Carpenters[/bold][/color] are kitted for this role exactly, starting with a laser that is designed for salvaging machines and walls and turning them into scrap that can be used for processing. If needs be, other roles are able to substitute for carpenters or assist existing ones. [color=yellow][bold]Acolytes[/color] should be protecting their workers as they operate.[/bold]
25 High Quality scrap can be converted into one [bold] iridite or plastitanium [/bold] directly at the designated MAWC milifab. This is necessary for most advanced equipment, specifically armor and heavy weapons like the [bold]Stonehenge[/bold] Anti Materiel Rifle.
Derelict hulls are your main target. Dead ships may carry walls and machines which can be turned into 1-15 [bold]High quality scrap[/bold], the lifeblood of your operation. Though a dead ship may also be missing a lot of equipment. [bold]Intact vessels[/bold] are not out of your scope, but double check if the vessel is really abandoned or if the owner is just absent!
If all else fails, you can visit INSO for plentiful quantities of salvageable structures to be turned into high quality scrap.
Dead ships can be hard to find given low thermal signature, so visiting common conflict sites is also a possible plan of action for acquiring more scrap. [bold]Be careful not to draw too much attention unless you are sufficiently geared for it.[/bold]
If you are properly desperate, you may advertise [bold]hunter-killer ship services[/bold], where you offer contracts to kill ships from a desired faction, usually a specific vessel. [bold]Make sure you have an equipped fleet for this![/bold] You dont want to take contracts to kill heavy targets and then fail to deliver, as you will lose out on potential scrap gain.
[bold][color=red]Remember that it is BUISNESS and not open warfare! Try to kill ONLY what you are told to hunt.[/bold][/color]
